title: XState persisted machine snapshot (formatVersion 1)
description: The JSON envelope returned by getPersistedSnapshot() for machine logic, after JSON.stringify/JSON.parse. Nested machine children carry their own envelope in children[id].snapshot; other actor logic (async, callback, transition, observable) persists its own snapshot shape there. Fields prefixed with '_' are private runtime bookkeeping: they round-trip verbatim, but their shape is not part of the contract.

formatVersion.description: Library-owned envelope format. Distinct from machine.version.

context.description: Application context. Actor refs are replaced by { xstate$type: 'actorRef', id }.

historyValue.description: History state id -> remembered state node ids.

stateInputs.description: State node id -> resolved state input. Omitted when empty.

machine.description: Machine identity. Present only when the machine declares a version.

version.description: Mirror of machine.version. Present only when the machine declares a version.

src.description: Registered source key the child is restored from.

snapshot.description: Embedded persisted snapshot of the child's logic. A machine child's snapshot is itself a formatVersion 1 envelope.

remote.description: The child is referenced by address; its state lives with another runtime.

incarnation.description: Host-supplied incarnation token of a remote child.

target.description: 'self', a child id, or the parent.

startedAt.description: Wall-clock start (ms). Written only under the wall clock.
